purpose: Teach: お手数/公費/机上/納める/コーポレート/コメンテーター/盛り込む/旅先

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察より、本気で、絶対、お手数、絶対、お掛けしますが、絶対、ご協力、絶対、お願いいたします、本気で、感謝
lines.en: We're from the police, and we're asking sincerely for your cooperation. Thank you.
lines.style: Professional, measured opening. Clear authority without harshness. Even pace, steady eye contact. The tone of someone used to being listened to.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。警察への、本気で、絶対、公費、絶対、協力、絶対、当社、絶対、いたします、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. Our company will cooperate fully with the police. We appreciate your work.
lines.style: Earnest and cooperative. Slight formal bow in the voice. Careful, deliberate pacing. Showing willingness without overdoing it.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 机上、本気で、絶対、データ、絶対、警察、絶対、現場、絶対、合わせて、絶対、判断、絶対、いたします、本気で、感謝
lines.en: We'll cross-reference the office data with the scene information before we reach any conclusions.
lines.style: Procedural and measured. Professional authority. Steady delivery, no rush. The clarity of someone explaining next steps to someone who should understand them.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。罰金、本気で、絶対、適正に、絶対、納める、絶対、よう、絶対、徹底しております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. We're ensuring all fines are processed correctly and thoroughly.
lines.style: Straightforward update. Respectful but not obsequious. Even pacing, practical tone. The voice of someone confirming completion of a task.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 各社の、本気で、絶対、コーポレート、絶対、コンプライアンス、絶対、警察、絶対、注視しております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: We're watching how each company handles this—corporate compliance is something we monitor closely.
lines.style: Formal authority with an undercurrent of scrutiny. Measured pace. The weight of institutional oversight in the tone. Not threatening, but clear about expectations.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。テレビの、本気で、絶対、コメンテーター、絶対、警察、絶対、ご意見、絶対、伺っております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. We're also taking note of what commentators and public voices are saying about the police's response.
lines.style: Careful, aware. Slightly measured—showing he understands the public dimension. Respectful but not defensive. The tone of someone navigating complexity.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察への、本気で、絶対、報告書、絶対、適切な情報、絶対、盛り込む、絶対、よう、絶対、お願いいたします、本気で、感謝
lines.en: When you submit your report to the police, please make sure all relevant information is included clearly.
lines.style: Polite but firm instruction. Professional courtesy with underlying expectation. Steady pace. The tone of someone setting clear parameters.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。警察出張、本気で、絶対、旅先、絶対、宿泊先、絶対、当社、絶対、ご紹介、絶対、いたします、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. If your officers need to travel for this investigation, we can help arrange accommodations.
lines.style: Hospitable practical offer. Warm but efficient. Shows partnership through concrete help. Even, slightly eager tone—genuine willingness beneath professional courtesy.
